thought.text: Node 22 is installed. Now the .NET 9 SDK via the dotnet-install script.

reasoning_content: Node 22 is installed. Next up is the .NET 9 SDK. Let's install it using the dotnet-install script (it doesn't require adding a Microsoft repository).

action.command: curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh && chmod +x /tmp/dotnet-install.sh && /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 9.0 --install-dir /usr/local/dotnet >/tmp/dotnet-install.log 2>&1; tail -8 /tmp/dotnet-install.log; ln -sf /usr/local/dotnet/dotnet /usr/local/bin/dotnet; dotnet --version
